outcomes: An editor, a translator's tool or an agent checks a catalog or a glossary file against a published schema, without running Putnami
The schemas and the @putnami/web reader accept and refuse the same files
nonGoals: The work file putnami i18n translate writes, which only the CLI and its skill read
A Go reader of catalogs: no Go code reads them

requirements.text: schemas/catalog.json and schemas/glossary.json are JSON Schema 2020-12 documents whose $id is https://putnami.dev/schemas/i18n/catalog.json and https://putnami.dev/schemas/i18n/glossary.json, where putnami.dev publishes them.

Every fixture is a JSON object. @putnami/web reads each valid catalog and glossary fixture and refuses each invalid one: an unknown field, an unknown state, a text that is not a string, a validated entry without validatedBy and validatedAt, an entry that is not an object, a glossary term without a translation or with an empty one.
